dominant_strengths: Top red gradient hairline plus glowing trash icon set a precise destructive-action tone without screaming
Tree-style connector from the Primary card down to its child items quietly visualizes deletion scope
Type-to-confirm with inline monospace token and disabled red button enforces a clear safety gate
dominant_weaknesses: Vertical rhythm is loose: gap between scope list, members row, and confirm input feels arbitrary, not modular
Avatar stack '+4' chip and 'PRIMARY' tag compete with the destructive red, slightly diluting hierarchy focus
Body copy and metadata sit at near-identical gray weights, flattening the scan path through the dialog
fix_priorities: Tighten and standardize spacing tokens between sections so the modal reads as three clear blocks
Reinforce typographic hierarchy: brighten primary line, mute secondary metadata further
Reserve red exclusively for the destructive trail; neutralize the PRIMARY badge to a quieter accent
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral red glow leads, behavioral confirm-gate is solid, reflective trust comes from the explicit member-impact line.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it executes a high-stakes destructive modal with scope disclosure and friction confirmation, on-brief if not boundary-pushing.
